results.title: Paul Heaton at the BBC
results.overview: One of Britain’s most prolific and successful singer-songwriters of the past four decades, Paul Heaton started his career as frontman of The Housemartins before forming The Beautiful South, the band of whom it was famously once claimed that one in seven UK households owns an album. Whether that's true or not, what is a fact is that Paul has demonstrated over the years a unique ability to write songs and lyrics that have fans weeping one moment and smiling the next.  This collection of performances and best BBC moments celebrates Paul’s impressive career - the bands, the collaborations and the solo work - and features the man himself explaining the context and backstories behind some of his best-loved hits.

results.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 5 - Lukas Sternath in Athens
results.original_title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 5 Lukas Sternath in Athens
results.overview: Written during the tumult of the Napoleonic Wars, Beethoven’s fifth and final piano concerto is both epic and moving. Young Austrian pianist Lukas Sternath is soloist with the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie Bremen, conducted by Constantinos Carydis performing from Pnyx Hill with a view of the ancient Acropolis as part of Europiano.

results.title: Umbag
results.overview: Two estranged sisters reunite but a tragedy tears them apart once more. As tensions rise, their struggles lead to the boxing ring, where their fight for redemption, forgiveness, and the true meaning of family takes center stage.

results.title: Human Holes
results.overview: A botched alien abduction leaves a combative pair fighting for their lives and the future of the planet.

results.title: Where the River Begins
results.overview: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

results.title: Return from Tomorrow
results.overview: Randy Moore’s follow-up to the (in)famously filmed-in-secret Disney World fever-dream Escape from Tomorrow is an absurdist paranoid conspiracy thriller featuring the original cast in a completely new scenario. After the loss of his father, a middle-aged dad spirals into a Lynchian crisis of masculinity while on family vacation in Miami. As his inadequacies and unspoken desires drift him further away from his wife, he uncovers a mysterious plot involving his father, the gas company, cocaine, prostitution, and . . . Walt?

results.title: Submissive Homeland
results.overview: Brazil truly has the "secret sauce," and people from the outside are taking notice.  While Trump, in the United States, has his eyes on our mineral wealth, Flávio Bolsonaro—a candidate for the Brazilian presidency—is promising to hand over our rare earth elements in an attempt to win an election.  In this episode, we interview General Santos Cruz, a former minister under Jair Bolsonaro, who states: this is not what it means to be right-wing, nor is it patriotic—it is complete submission. Our minerals are strategic, both for us and for the world. The question that remains is: who will own this wealth in the years to come? Will you just sit by while it’s handed over to Trump on a silver platter?

results.title: Wax & Gold
results.overview: Starting from a hotel in Addis Ababa built by Emperor Haile Selassie, Ruth Beckermann explores a place both familiar and foreign to her. Archive footage and conversations on the ground combine personal reflections with the histories of Ethiopia and Europe.

results.title: They Come Out of Margo
results.overview: All fears, anxieties and hopes are embodied in the character of Margo, a songwriter who was once famous but who now isolates herself in her apartment. A party held to celebrate her 40th birthday and the emotions that are born there unexpectedly help Margo enter a new stage in her life.

results.title: God Skin
results.original_title: หมัดเทวา ท้าเดิมพัน
results.overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

results.title: A Dance with Rainbows
results.overview: At 20, Ling balances boxing and helping with her mother's lunchbox business, all while her family quietly unravels. Her parents fake harmony, but when her father brings home a new "girlfriend," the illusion is shattered. Refusing to look away, Ling endures the blows - bloodied and tear-streaked. In facing reality head-on, she discovers a deeper truth: only with honesty in her heart do her punches carry real weight.

results.title: Pickleballers
results.overview: After racking up $25,000 in fines due to her anger issues, a young woman enters a high-stakes pickleball tournament with her friends to win the cash prize, despite having no experience and facing a ruthless rival with a champion partner.

results.title: Aazhi
results.overview: Mukhila's Father Murthy comes to know about Arul and Mukhilas love affair. Murthy, who works as a boat mechanic, kidnaps Arul in a boat and beats him up. He plans to kill Arul so that he will not fall in love with his daughter. When the boat breaks down in the sea, Murthy, foot stuck in the motor and is both of them survived the rainstorm or not.

results.overview: In Marseilles, the sale of Skander's barber shop depends on a decision that Juliette, a young Parisian woman, must make. Meanwhile, Mehdi, the apprentice, is waiting on a crucial call from the bank that could determine his future.

results.title: Grandmasters
results.overview: The once esoteric and uninspired world of competitive chess is thrown into turmoil when an eccentric German entrepreneur enlists reigning champion Magnus Carlsen to launch a new league that aims to revolutionize the game, challenge the sport's governing body, and "make chess cool."
